install: ([ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env) && ([ -f frontend/.env.local ] || cp frontend/env.example frontend/.env.local) && (if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d && for i in $(seq 1 30); do if docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres pg_isready -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; sleep 1; done && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres pg_isready -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; fi) && cargo fetch && cargo build --all-targets && npm ci --prefix frontend --no-audit --no-fund
